Why the change?
 Asheville Citizen-Times Tue, October 27, 2026 at 12:31 PM EDT Supplemental Security Income payments for November in North Carolina will change temporarily. When to expect your Social Security payment. 
 Video Transcript 00:00 Speaker A Supplemental security income recipients are getting November's payment early 
 00:06 Speaker A with money scheduled for Friday, October 30th. 
 00:10 Speaker A Payments generally arrive on the first. 
 00:12 Speaker A The change is occurring because November 1st falls on a Sunday this year. 
 00:17 Speaker A Meanwhile, October's final regular social security payment is scheduled for Wednesday, October 28th. 
 00:24 Speaker A That payment goes to beneficiaries whose birthdays fall between the 21st and 31st. 
 00:30 Speaker A The next supplemental security income payment dates are Tuesday, December 1st and Thursday, December 31st.
